title: Who gets talked about? What the public looks up on Wikipedia, and what Parliament talks about
excerpt: I set a year of Wikipedia reading against twenty-one years of Commons debate for 1,425 UK towns and cities. The two mostly agree, but a town with a seat named after it gets 2.2 times the mentions, and Welsh places are talked about more, not less.
seo_description: Which UK places does the public look up on Wikipedia, and which does Parliament talk about? 1,425 towns compared, 2005 to 2025.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Who gets talked about?' beside a map of UK places coloured from blue to red by how often the Commons mentions them against their Wikipedia views.
